data.description:
Specifications:

  • 100% brand new and high quality

  • Material:Nylon+Plastic

  •    Battery: 2 Button Battery (included)

  • The dog collar made of nylon,plastic,sturdy durable and wear resistant.

  • Have 3 adjustable lighting modes:constant on,fast flash and slow flash,shut down

  • It is easy and convenient to wear and remove with buckle.

  • Flashing dog collar is ideal for walking at night,makes your pet unique in the dark.

  • Shiny collar is an excellent way to ensure both you and your pet's safety.

  • Perfect for dogs,puppys,cats and so on pets in the dark.

  • This is a good gift to your friend.

  • All dimensions are measured by hand, there may be 2-3cm deviations,thanks for your understanding

  • As different computers display colors differently, the color of the actual item may vary slightly from the above images, thanks for your understanding.

【Size specifications】

M code Width 2.5cm Short 40cm Length 48cm Telescopic range 8cm

L code Width 2.5cm Short 45cm Length 52cm Telescopic range 8cm

XL code width 2.5cm short 52cm length 60cm telescopic range 8cm

Package Include:

  •   1Pcs  Pet Collar
